text: あの　いせきが　あやしいのだが…

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: のだ is the full, stiffer form of んだ and shows the speaker is explaining what he thinks. あやしいのだ = 'the thing is, they're suspicious'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end means 'but', and trailing off leaves the rest unsaid. あやしいのだが = 'they're suspicious, but...'
